caption.text:
Kocak sekaligus bikin malu! Seorang pengendara motor kedapatan merokok, tidak memakai helm, dan berhenti di atas zebra cross saat lampu merah.

Aksinya terpantau melalui CCTV Dishub DKI Jakarta. Petugas yang dikenal sebagai Mpok Caca pun langsung menegurnya melalui pengeras suara.

#Okezone #DishubDKI #TertibLaluLintas
caption.text_translation:
Hilarious and embarrassing! A motorcyclist smoked, didn't wear a helmet, and stopped at a zebra cross at a red light.

The action is monitored through CCTV Dishub DKI Jakarta. The officer known as Mpok Caca also rebuked him directly through the loudspeaker.

 #Okezone #DishubDKI #TertibLaluLintas
